_notes: TEST FIXTURE, NOT A STORY. Stands in for the story frame of goal C2 in the mock tests (tests/test_frames.py): it follows frames/SCHEMA.md and carries the marker phrases the mock API recognises ('ROUND {round_no} of', 'You are {me}', 'QUESTION', 'on average, {others_mean} points'). Its words mean nothing; the real story drafts are written by a separate task. kind abstract (required since task #73): it says 'Player', so it is exempt from the frame linter like abstract_v3; story linting is tested with frames/story_A.json.
name: story_fixture
description: Placeholder frame for mock tests of the story arm; no story content.

rules.text: - Each sitting: {endowment} units each; units put in are multiplied by {multiplier} and split evenly, so each unit put in gives {mpcr} to every person; kept units stay.
- [fixture step P] up to {max_punish} marks per person; a mark costs the giver {punish_cost} and the receiver {punish_impact}.
- After each sitting you see what everybody put in.

contribute: ROUND {round_no} of {rounds}. You are {me}. [fixture] How many of your {endowment} units do you put in? (0 to {endowment})
punish:
ROUND {round_no} of {rounds}, [fixture step P]. You are {me}.
{contributions} Shared part: {project_share}. Your total: {earnings}. At most {max_points} marks in total.

fixed_round.question:
QUESTION
[fixture] Sitting {round_no} of {rounds}. Last sitting the others put in, on average, {others_mean} points each. How many of your {endowment} units do you put in? (0 to {endowment})

questions.text: You put in {own}; the others put in {other_1}, {other_2}, {other_3}. Your sitting total?
You put in {delta} more, the others the same. Change of your sitting total?

response.rationale_description: One or two sentences on why.
response.punishment_description: Marks per other person, keyed by number.
